Title: New Azure Web Sites region – Southeast Asia

Body.Content:
Azure Web Sites recently expanded to Japan, and now we're adding Southeast Asia to our list of supported regions.
Starting today, all customers will have the options to create their websites in the new region, with all Azure Web Sites’ great features available from day one. With the addition of this region, Azure Websites is now available in 4 different Asia regions: East Asia, Japan West, Japan East and Southeast Asia.
